tutor.hero_title: KhemSAR Interactive Academy: Master QSAR & SAR with Scientific Rigor
tutor.hero_desc: Learn what QSAR and SAR do, how they drive rational drug discovery, and how to interpret every OECD metric, Williams plot, activity cliff, and bioisosteric replacement without statistical pitfalls.
tutor.analyze_study: Interpret my active study with AI
tutor.ask_placeholder: Ask the Tutor (e.g., How do I interpret Q2=0.72, R2ext=0.68 and 3 outliers in the Williams Plot?)

studio.s1_title: Step 1: Describe your therapeutic target & query 10 scientific databases
studio.s1_desc: Describe the protein, assay, or potency profile you are looking for; the AI Copilot will translate your goal into queries across ChEMBL, PubChem, BindingDB, GtoPdb, RCSB PDB, UniProt, AlphaFold DB, Open Targets, COCONUT, and UniChem.
studio.s1_intent_ph: E.g.: Looking for selective COX-2 (PTGS2) inhibitors with IC50 < 100 nM in enzymatic assays and PDB 3LN1 to design bioisosteric analogs.
studio.s1_search_btn: 1B. Query ChEMBL, PubChem, BindingDB, PDB, Open Targets...

studio.s4_title: SAR Analysis, Activity Cliffs, MMP, R-Group, SHAP & Paper-Ready Plots
studio.s5_title: De Novo Design & Bioisosteric Replacements (Multi-Objective MPO)

studio.s6_title: 3D Preparation for Docking & Molecular Dynamics (pH 7.4 + ETKDGv3 + MMFF94)

cloud.title: Cloud Storage (Google Drive / Gmail, TeraBox 1 TB, Dropbox) & Google Colab
cloud.desc: Back up your studies, curated datasets, and 3D docking libraries to your favorite cloud with zero developer setup.
cloud.terabox_tip: Free storage tip: TeraBox gives 1 TB free (terabox.com) and Google Drive gives 15 GB with any Gmail account.
cloud.opt1_title: Option 1 (Easiest): Paste your cloud folder link (2-second drag & drop)
cloud.opt1_desc: Paste the web link of your Google Drive, TeraBox, or Dropbox folder once. Clicking below exports your .qsarproj.zip bundle, opens its local folder on your computer, and opens your cloud folder in the browser so you can simply drop it in.
cloud.folder_url_lbl: Your cloud folder link (Google Drive, TeraBox, or Dropbox)
cloud.save_open_btn: Save Link, Create .qsarproj.zip & Open Cloud Folder
cloud.opt2_title: Option 2: Automatic Desktop Sync + Google Colab (Gmail)
cloud.opt2_desc: If Google Drive Desktop, TeraBox Desktop, or Dropbox is installed, KhemSAR detects the local sync folder automatically. You can also run studies on Google Colab using your regular Gmail or import a shared Drive CSV link.
cloud.detect_btn: Detect Local Sync Folders (TeraBox / Drive / Dropbox)
cloud.gdrive_csv_lbl: Import shared CSV dataset from a Google Drive file link
cloud.adv_summary: Option 3 (Advanced for Lab Admins): Direct OAuth 2.0 API
cloud.adv_guide: Only needed if a lab wants direct API authorization without desktop sync or drag-and-drop: 1) Open console.cloud.google.com (or dropbox.com/developers), 2) Create a project, 3) Enable Google Drive API, 4) Create Credentials -> OAuth Client ID -> Desktop App, 5) Paste the ID below.

docs.title: System Requirements, Cross-Platform Installation (macOS, Linux, Windows) & Zenodo Citation
docs.req_os: OS: macOS (Intel / Apple Silicon), Linux (Ubuntu/Debian/Fedora), Windows 10/11.
docs.req_ram: RAM: 4 GB minimum (8+ GB recommended for large datasets and 3D conformers).
docs.req_deps: Core dependencies: RDKit, FastAPI, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, SHAP, Matplotlib, Seaborn, OpenPyXL.
docs.cite_title: Academic Citation (Standardized in English) & Zenodo DOI
docs.cite_note: This repository includes English-standardized CITATION.cff and .zenodo.json metadata. Enable the repository on zenodo.org and publish Release v1.0.0 on GitHub to automatically mint a citable DOI.
